id: title:Gilbert09:recognize 401 403 with empty reason phrase as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion connector reliability and error classification for Zoho CRM authentication failures.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate a substantive, bounded improvement: P1.F1.H1 adds test assertions for Zoho CRM 401/403 responses with blank reason phrases, while P1.F2.H1 updates the warehouse ingestion connector's error dictionary to classify these specific responses as non-retryable. This prevents unnecessary retry loops and account exhaustion, supporting warehouse connector data,
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk IDs; no surrounding implementation, broader change group, or test execution results are available. The tier assumes the supplied hunks represent the complete implementation and relevant checks, which cannot be independently verified. No unverified outcomes or adoption are inferred.

observations.behavior: Adds test cases for ZohoCRM 401 and 403 responses with blank reason phrases, alongside existing Marketo 401 cases.
observations.posthog_connection: These assertions check that the warehouse ingestion system correctly identifies and classifies authentication and permission errors from Zoho CRM, preventing retry loops or misclassification. This supports warehouse connector reliability.

observations.behavior: Adds entries to the non-retryable error dictionary for Zoho CRM responses with blank reason phrases, alongside existing entries with full reason phrases.
observations.code_quote: "401 Client Error:  for url": "Your Zoho CRM access token is invalid or expired. Reconnect the source to issue a new one.",
